definitions.gloss: postnatal; after giving birth; the postpartum period
definitions.explanation: The period following childbirth. Used as a noun or prenominal modifier to describe the physical, emotional, or lifestyle aspects of a mother's or infant's life after birth.

examples.japanese: {産後|さんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{時間|じかん}→時間：00468_jikan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦かかった→かかる：00711_kakaru⟧。
{産後|さんご}うつ⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦も→も：00484_mo⟧⟦{少|すく}なくない→少ない：01136_sukunai⟧。
examples.english: There are quite a few people who develop postpartum depression.

examples.japanese: {産後|さんご}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{体|からだ}→体：00784_karada⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ホルモン→ホルモン：29936_horumon⟧⟦バランス→バランス：03870_baransu⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{大|おお}きく→大きい：00335_ookii⟧⟦{変|か}わる→変わる：00714_kawaru⟧⟦ため→ため：01145_tame⟧、⟦{精神的|せいしんてき}→精神的：05851_seishinteki⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{不安定|ふあんてい}→不安定：11318_fuantei⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なり→なる：01970_naru⟧やすい。
examples.english: After childbirth, hormone balance changes dramatically, making it easy to become emotionally unstable.

notes:
Compound of {産|さん} (birth, childbirth) + ⟦{後|ご}→後：30157_go⟧ (after). Used as a noun ({産後|さんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: postpartum recovery) or temporal adverb ({産後|さんご}⟦すぐ→すぐ：00814_sugu⟧: immediately after childbirth).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {産後|さんご}うつ: postpartum depression
- {産後|さんご}⟦ケア→ケア：10848_kea⟧: postpartum care
- {産後|さんご}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{回復|かいふく}→回復：03812_kaifuku⟧: postpartum recovery
- {産後|さんご}{太|ふと}り: weight gain after childbirth
- {産後|さんご}⟦{直後|ちょくご}→直後：04525_chokugo⟧: immediately after birth

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {産前|さんぜん}: before childbirth — the prenatal period
- {出産後|しゅっさんご}: after delivery — equivalent but more explicit
- ⟦{育児|いくじ}→育児：03998_ikuji⟧: child-rearing — covers the broader period of raising an infant
